signals.text: Demo: two recent Google reviews say they couldn't get through on the phone
signals.source: Google Business Profile (made up for the demo)

bestTime: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or after 5pm

sections.label: Before you dial
sections.body:
This is a demo so you can see how a script looks. It disappears once real leads arrive and never counts in the stats.
Who: Gary, owner of a one-van plumbing and heating firm in Dalkeith.
Why him: two recent Google reviews say people couldn't get through on the phone.
Best time: Tue to Thu, 7:30 to 8:30am, or after 5pm.
Tick TPS / CTPS before you dial.
What you want: a 15-minute chat, on the phone or you pop in.
Stand up, slow down on your name, and stop talking after every question.

sections.label: If someone else answers
sections.body:
Hi, it's Dean Finlayson, is Gary about?
_(if they ask what it's about)_ It's about the calls that come in when Gary's out on a job. Is he the right person for that?
_(if he's out)_ No bother. When's the best time to catch him? _(write their name in the note)_

sections.label: Opener
sections.body:
Hi Gary, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One. _(slow)_
This is a cold call, so I'll be quick. Can I have 30 seconds to say why I'm calling, and you tell me if it's worth carrying on?
_(stop and wait)_
sections.original:
Hi Gary, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One. _(slow)_
This is a cold call, so I'll be quick. Can I have 30 seconds to say why I'm calling, and you tell me if it's worth carrying on?
_(stop and wait)_

sections.label: Why I'm calling
sections.body:
The reason I'm calling is I was on your Google page. Loads of great reviews, but a couple of the recent ones say they couldn't get through on the phone.
That usually means you're under a sink when it rings, and by the time you call back they've booked someone else.
Is that something that happens to you, or am I way off?

sections.label: Questions
sections.body:
Q: When you're on a job and the phone goes, what happens to that call?
Q: Last week, roughly how many did you miss, would you say?
Q: And when you ring them back, how often have they already found someone?
Listen for: a job he lost, evenings spent on quotes, his partner answering the phone for him.

sections.label: If it's a problem for them
sections.body:
That's what I build. I set it up so every missed call gets a text back straight away, so the customer waits for you instead of ringing the next number.
I'm in Bonnyrigg, I build it myself, and you deal with me, not a call centre.

sections.label: The ask
sections.body:
Easier to show you than explain. Fifteen minutes, on the phone or I'll pop in to you. Thursday at 8, or Friday after 5, which is better?
_(if he hesitates)_ No commitment. If it's not for you, no bother at all.

sections.label: If they push back
sections.body:
They: I'm not interested.
You: Fair enough, most folk aren't till they know why I'm calling. Quick one before I go: when the phone rings and you're up a ladder, does that call get answered?

They: My missus answers the phone.
You: That's good, a lot don't have that. What happens after six, or when she's not in?

They: Send me an email.
You: Will do. So I don't send you something you'll bin, is missing calls actually a thing for you, or are you on top of it?

They: How much is it?
You: Depends what you need. It's a one-off build and then a small monthly. I'd rather show you first than throw a number at you. Fifteen minutes, Thursday or Friday?

They: We're too small for that.
You: That's exactly who I build it for. Bigger firms have an office doing this. You've got you.

They: Don't call me again.
You: No problem, I'll take you off. Sorry for the interruption, all the best. _(Log as Do not call)_

sections.label: Voicemail
sections.body: Hi Gary, it's Dean Finlayson from Level One in Edinburgh. I'm calling about the calls you miss when you're on a job. I'll drop you a text with what I mean. You can get me back on this number. Again, it's Dean from Level One. Cheers.

sections.label: When they say yes
sections.body:
Brilliant. So that's Thursday at 8. Is this the best number for you, or is there a mobile?
I'll text you now so you've got my number. I'll bring a quick example for your business.
